description: Use this for questions about the past — 'how many hours did I stream last month', 'is my spend going up' — not about the present. Returns minutes streamed, credits spent and session counts bucketed over a period and split by output quality. get_billing_overview has the current balance and burn rate instead. Returns usageAnalytics: totalMinutes, totalCredits, sessionCount, byQuality[] (quality, minutes, credits) and buckets[] (date, minutes, credits, sessions).

endDate.description: End of the window as an RFC3339 instant. Omitted: now.

period.description: The span to report on. It sets the buckets (hourly for DAY, daily for WEEK and MONTH, monthly for QUARTER and YEAR) and, without startDate, the window: the last day, week, month, quarter or year.

startDate.description: Start of the window as an RFC3339 instant, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z. Omitted: one period before now.

name: get_streaming_usage

buckets.description: One per hour (DAY), day (WEEK, MONTH) or month (QUARTER, YEAR).

code.description: Stable — branch on it: INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_PUBLISH, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, UNAVAILABLE, …

currentRevision.description: CONFLICT: the revision it has now

detail.description: What is wrong, in a sentence

errors.description: Each problem, when a check refused it

title: Streaming usage history
